content.thinking: A test bug: my "tight capacities" generator can pick cap = 0 (when `vals` contains 0 — e.g., g values of 0 for stages with no nodes). The reference then divides by 0. My solver would reject cap=0 as invalid (capacities must be positive), but here I'm calling solve_cuts directly with cap=0 — the C code treats cap=0 as "U must be 0" which is a different semantic. Since real requests validate caps ≥ 1, this test case is unrealistic. Let me fix the generator to only pick positive caps.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
p='/app/tmp/test_final.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    vals = sorted(set(v for v in gs.values()))",
            "    vals = sorted(set(v for v in gs.values() if v > 0))")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
time python3 /app/tmp/test_final.py
